sentences.text: In short: TPX EIENDOM AS is an established company in "utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom" based in Fredrikstad, profitable in 2025.

TPX EIENDOM AS is registered in the industry "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom"; its registered activity is "Selv, gjennom hel- eller deleide selskaper eller ved samarbeid med andre virksomheter, å investere i eiendom.".
TPX EIENDOM AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2016-09-23, registered in Fredrikstad.
It reported revenue of NOK 72,000 for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 3,820 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 5.3% and a moderate equity ratio of 15% of total assets.
Revenue was flat from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 72,000 to NOK 72,000); it was NOK 72,000 in 2023. The annual result was a profit in 2025, as in 2024 (2023: -NOK 1,680, 2024: NOK 7,967, 2025: NOK 2,972).
TPX EIENDOM AS is led by board chair Trond Paulsen.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2018-06-15.
TPX EIENDOM AS has 1 registered workplace.
